submitted_root_cause: The cartservice has a service selector misconfiguration where the service selector {'app': 'cartservice-missing'} does not match any pods. The deployment pods have labels {'app': 'cartservice', 'pod-template-hash': '6d57458d89'} but the service is looking for pods with label 'cartservice-missing'. This mismatch prevents the service from routing traffic to the healthy running pods, resulting in 0 effective endpoints and no traffic flow (0 RPS).
submitted_action: Patch the cartservice service selector to match the actual pod labels by changing the selector from {'app': 'cartservice-missing'} to {'app': 'cartservice'} so the service can properly route traffic to the deployment pods.
